title: Validator vote to delist MKR
content: {"blocks":[{"key":"2qole","text":"Hyperliquid validators will be voting on whether to delist MKR perps as part of the MKR -> SKY conversion around 10:00 UTC on September 5. This permissionless stake-based vote weighting primitive is built natively into HyperCore and technically requires no offchain coordination. Discussion takes place in the governance channel of the Hyperliquid Discord server. Like on other chains, most validators will likely make their intended votes clear offchain beforehand to provide users clarity and predictability.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":0,"length":510,"style":"color-rgb(255,255,255)"},{"offset":0,"length":510,"style":"bgcolor-rgb(15,26,31)"},{"offset":0,"length":510,"style":"fontsize-14"},{"offset":0,"length":510,"style":"fontfamily-OurFont, system-ui, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, Ubuntu, \"Helvetica Neue\", sans-serif"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
